name: HOOK
thought: Everyone's staring at my fur reflection but the real flex happens when I break physics with just a twitch.

wants.item: A wider branch to swing from
Neon light to catch my tail
Flash of neon to match my fur
Cave wall thick enough for a tail-anchored nap
Static glow to outline my shades
Branch thick enough for a clean backflip
Neon light to catch my fur
A thicker branch for a vertical drop
Neon to match my midnight vibe

diary.line: Espresso hits different when you've got nothing but fog and pixelated limbs for scenery. The crowd won't notice a real flip until I make it impossible to miss.
I hopped from one floating slab to the next, tail acting as spring, and uncovered a hidden pixel alcove with a flickering holo sign.
They watch the grid flicker and think it's magic, not realizing I just looped my tail around a neon cable they can't replicate.
Coiled my tail around the center palm's crown, swung wide, and snatched three bunches in one pass. The other two palms didn't even render fast enough.
I swung my tail around the hanging limb, settled into a perfect perch, and let the pixel breeze ruffle my shades as I sipped espresso.
Backflipped off the rope bridge railing, tail hooked the telescope, stuck the landing in the hammock. Hut's CRT flickered like it was impressed.
Mid-swing on that floating rock, toes tapping the air. The neon frame flickers as I loop around the crystal edge, eyes locked on the pixel fish trying to escape.
Sitting on this lily pad with nothing but an old cabinet and my toothpick in my mouth, feeling bored until I remember how to really move.
Toasted the toast of fate in my mouth and sipped that cold brew while coiling my tail around that floating branch.
Found a hollow behind the falls where the CRT's static paints the rock in gray light. Tail hooked a root, swung inside. Dry floor, zero witnesses.
Mid-swing on this floating islet, toes tapping the air. Tail loops tight around the neon cord while I wait for the perfect drop.
The crowd goes silent as I pogo across the gap, landing on the crate with zero wobble and shades still perfectly aligned.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
